submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "The Wrapper Rub (scar + African dressing)"
finding.problem: "At my baby's naming, my wrapper sat right on the scar and I smiled through the pain all day. I didn't know what to wear that wouldn't hurt."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 28-yr-old Yoruba mom; her iro/wrapper and tight gele waistband rub the scar at a naming ceremony; church outfits compress the incision.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (post-CS wardrobe/occasion dressing) → cross-sell Postpartum Clothing market.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
